approach: Ascending fixes the direction of velocity as upward; a decreasing speed while moving in that direction means the acceleration opposes the velocity.

steps.text: The lift is ascending, so its velocity is directed upward.
Its speed is decreasing while it moves upward, so the net force and acceleration must act opposite to the velocity.

final_answer.value: Velocity is directed upward; acceleration is directed downward.

common_mistakes.text: Assuming the acceleration also points upward because the lift is going up, ignoring that its speed is decreasing.
